name: cognee-memory
description: Persistent memory for Claude Code, built on Cognee's knowledge graph. Captures your prompts, tool calls and answers, recalls what's relevant on every prompt, and carries decisions and lessons into later sessions. Runs locally or on Cognee Cloud.

cognee_base_url.title: Cognee Cloud URL
cognee_base_url.description: Your Cognee Cloud instance, such as https://your-instance.cognee.ai. Leave empty to run Cognee locally on this machine.

cognee_api_key.title: Cognee Cloud API key
cognee_api_key.description: The ck_… key from your Cognee Cloud account. Needed only with a Cloud URL.

llm_api_key.title: LLM API key (local mode)
llm_api_key.description: The model provider key the local Cognee server builds memory with (OpenAI by default). Leave empty to use your Claude subscription through the claude CLI instead.
